name: Intraday time-series momentum — first-window sign continues into the close window (1h)
rationale: MECHANISM: the Gao/Bogousslavsky intraday-momentum result ported to crypto (Birmingham/Reading papers): the sign of the early intraday window return positively predicts the last window's return within the same session, driven by late-informed traders and end-of-window rebalancing/hedging demand that pushes price in the established direction; early liquidity providers who under-react are the counterparty. Expressed as a rolling continuation: a strong positive signed trailing return (ret_Nd over the session window) gated by adx>floor (trend-not-chop) enters on continuation. DISCONFIRMER: kill if the net edge is < 3x round-trip taker cost (per-trade move is small at 1h so fees dominate), if the adx gate does nothing (edge identical gate on vs off), or if the signed early-window return has no monotonic link to the close-window return in a purged/embargoed OOS split (in-sample fit, not a persistent lead-lag).
catalyst: early-session momentum persisting into the close window
